provenance: Independent pause-adjusted arithmetic over raw case round_records and raw memory replay JSON. Common pause mask: iid seed 404 round 119; dirichlet_0.1 seed 404 round 100. For each affected partition/seed, that round is excluded for all three cases and B/E/D; all other seeds retain all 200 rounds. No median replacement. Initialization and shared preparation/loading are retained. Quality/target/training records are unchanged.
case_timer_method: generation=sum retained round generation_seconds; head=initialization_seconds+sum retained pipeline_seconds; C0+head=common_preparation_seconds+shared_loading_seconds+head.
